name: síofra
text: síofra is an anglicized form MacKillop records for the Irish síodhbhradh. The figure is the changeling of Irish tradition, a fairy-substituted infant. The full record sits under the headword changeling.

attributes.attribute: Anglicized form of síodhbhradh; pointer to changeling headword

okr.objective: síofra is a MacKillop signpost for the changeling headword.
key_results: Signpost cites changeling as the canonical headword.
